rulings.restated: Input — Federal income tax withheld (box 2 of a Form W-2; on a Form W-2AS, W-2CM, W-2GU or W-2VI, box 2 is American Samoa, CNMI, Guam or U.S. Virgin Islands income tax, not federal income tax, so enter zero for it)
rulings.model: The restatement says to enter zero for box 2 on Forms W-2AS, W-2CM, W-2GU, or W-2VI, but the IRS text says: “For Forms W-2AS, W-2CM, W-2GU, or W-2VI, show the total American Samoa, CNMI, Guam, or U.S. Virgin Islands income tax withheld.”
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; iw2w3 p. 17, Box 2: "Show the total federal income tax withheld from the employee's wages for the year" and "For Forms W-2AS, W-2CM, W-2GU, or W-2VI, show the total American Samoa, CNMI, Guam, or U.S. Virgin Islands income tax withheld." The quote supports the restatement (round-2 fix, w2#2): on those forms box 2 is territorial tax, not federal income tax withheld, so the federal withholding entered from them is zero. Project stands.
